images.title: The *AI marketing* assistant
images.sub: Posts scheduled, reports built, leads followed up, and the marketing decisions that stay with a person.

images.name: duties
images.title: Marketing operations, *duty by duty*
rows: Drafts approved posts, schedules them and checks the next morning that each one published.
Pulls numbers from every account onto one page and notes what moved. Read-only on ads.
Adds each lead to the CRM within minutes, sends the follow-up and books calls.
Sends review requests and thanks happy customers. Complaints go to a person.
Builds each campaign from an approved brief and sends a test for approval.
Recommends. A person approves prices, offers, results and budget changes.
